    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 1.4rem;">These two callings grow out of years of hands-on work. Between 2006 and 2013, Y.E.T. Compassion drilled water wells, delivered food aid and medical supplies, and supported schooling in the Biong community of South Sudan — until the war that broke out in 2013 forced the work on the ground to pause. The school in Juba continues what that war interrupted.</p>
    <a href="/about/index.qmd" style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0B1F3B; text-decoration: none;">Read the full story of our work →</a>
